description: Change a Nomads.com meetup the member organized: date, time, type, title, description, venue or address. Fields left out keep their current value. The change is posted in the community chat. Once 2+ people RSVP'd, the date and time can no longer change. Call without meetup_id to get the member's upcoming meetups with their ids. Authenticated as the member, like create_meetup. Ask the member to confirm the change first.

description.description: What you will do. No paid tickets or selling

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

meetup_id.description: From create_meetup, list_meetups, or this tool called without it

time.description: Local start time as a whole hour, e.g. 19 or 19:00

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

venue.description: Name of the cafe, bar or restaurant

name: edit_meetup
